scope: Line-anchored named PHP function candidates and top-level blocks in first-party application/modules, excluding translations and migration history. Lexical candidates may include false positives. Anonymous closures belong to their enclosing segment. Not an exhaustive runtime call graph.
meaning: boundary_tested means only the outcomes in evidence were exercised with synthetic local fixtures. It never means the whole consumer is isolated or secondary-company operation is ready. All full_operation_ready values remain false pending cross-consumer, MySQL, concurrency and HTTP proof.
